societies.name: Revelation Space (The Yellowstone Demarchy before the Melding Plague)
societies.society: The pre-plague Yellowstone system's demarchic post-scarcity order

scope.continuity: Reynolds's Revelation Space continuity, including its prequel depictions
scope.period: The established high-technology order before the Melding Plague; the Prefect-era Band supplies same-period institutional context
scope.population: Living residents of the Yellowstone demarchic system and its participating habitats
exclusions: All habitats assumed to have identical internal institutions
The Conjoiners or Ultras assigned demarchic rules
Stored bodies or passive files counted as active people

societies.description:
Before the Melding Plague, Yellowstone's demarchic civilization combines extensive automatic infrastructure with broad material abundance. Sources describe the earlier city and orbital communities as near or effectively post-scarcity, rather than societies whose basic output requires a large conventional workforce. This supports substantial guarantees for residents, qualified by the lack of a single documented universal entitlement charter. The later destruction of the system belongs to a different period.

Citizen implants allow continuous participation in public decisions, and habitats retain considerable autonomy. These arrangements favor distributed human control rather than a single owner or an autonomous machine government. They also permit diverse local choices, so the system-wide coordinate is an approximate common reference point, not a claim that every habitat is identical. Police, artists and other useful workers remain. Neither abundance nor elaborate voting automation supplies an all-resident nonworking percentage. The orbital setting alone is not a reason to add another equivalent economic point when the Glitter Band lead is reached.

guarantees.basis: Independent setting accounts describe broad abundance with automatic infrastructure; a universal formal guarantee is not established for every habitat.

control.basis: Continuous citizen voting and local habitat autonomy support dispersed effective human control, with local differences retained.

nonworking.basis: Useful professions and varied habitat lifestyles remain; no all-resident participation estimate is supported.

evidence.claim: The pre-plague system has broad abundance; demarchic public control coexists with diverse local communities.
evidence.locator: Indexed pre-plague city, voting and Glitter Band setting accounts

uncertainties: Reference-led umbrella record; materially different local economies would need their own evidence before a split.
The catastrophe is not silently included in an earlier guarantee score.
No complete primary novel read or work census is claimed.

review.method: Second pass against the gathered passages, including explicit uncertainty; no independent reviewer

decisions.follow_up: Skip further investigation in this pass.

decisions.reason: The indexed passages show changing creator-imposed rules for a nonhuman simulated population, without a stable scoped post-work arrangement.
decisions.analysis: Substrate support, manipulated famines and later scientific labor must not be merged into one universal leisure society; the population proxy also needs justification.
decisions.follow_up: Skip a full-story reconstruction in the faster pass.

decisions.reason: Clear references establish the pre-plague demarchic order's automatic support, abundance and distributed public control.

review_notes: Continues the user's faster reference pass without full-story reading, downloaded novels or technical reconstruction.
The Splinter, jewel technology and a postmortal sporting scene do not inherit another Egan society's economic arrangements.
The Yellowstone record deliberately covers the pre-plague demarchic system. The later Glitter Band lead must be checked for economic duplication, not counted again for location alone.
Second pass checked scope and sources; universal charters and participation rates remain unstated where not supported.
